| GET    | `/settings`                    | settings.read                                      | `settings.get`                |                                                                                                                                            | `{ data: { ai: {..., hasApiKey, apiKeyFromEnvironment, apiKeyUnreadable, canStoreApiKey}, environment } }`                                                                                                                                                                             |
| PUT    | `/settings`                    | settings.read, settings.update                     | `settings.update`             | `{ ai: { enabled, provider, baseUrl, model, maxInputChars, maxOutputTokens, apiKey? } }`                                                   | same as GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| POST   | `/settings/ai/test`            | settings.read, settings.update                     | `settings.testAi`             | `{ ai: {...} }`                                                                                                                            | `{ data: { ok: true } }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

Details:

- Ids in paths are `documentId`s (`/^[a-z0-9]{1,64}$/`). Field targets: `uid` `api::x.y` or `plugin::x.y`, `field` a dotted path (`body`, `sections.0.body`) that must resolve to a Magic Editor X attribute, `locale` a locale code (required in effect for localised types; defaults to the default locale).
- Validation errors: `ValidationError` 400 with `details: { formErrors, fieldErrors }`, keys are dotted paths (`ai.apiKey`, `fields.2.name`).
- Access denied or missing document: 404. Viewer trying to write a version: 403.
- Internal links (`services/links.js`): the search combines the permission checker's `sanitizedQuery.read({})` filters (conditions, locale permissions) with `{ <title>: { $containsi: q } }` (Strapi escapes LIKE wildcards), reads draft versions with the Document Service (`fields` limited to `documentId`, title and the first `uid` attribute, each only when `pc.cannot.read(null, field)` is false), and passes every row through `sanitizeOutput`. Title: Content Manager `mainField` when it is a text attribute, else the first text attribute; without a readable title `q` only matches an exact `documentId`. `status` (`draft` \| `published`) only for Draft & Publish types. `href` is `renderLinkPattern(links.urlPattern, ...)` from `shared/link-pattern.mjs`.
- Stored internal link: `<a href data-mex-uid data-mex-document-id data-mex-locale>`. `shared/sanitize-policy.mjs` `cleanInternalLinkAttributes` keeps the three attributes only on `<a>`, only with valid values (`api::` uid, documentId, locale) and only when uid and documentId are both present; the server (sanitize-html `transformTags.a`) and the admin (DOMPurify `afterSanitizeAttributes`) both use it. The hyperlink tool's Editor.js `sanitize` config allows them too.
- Custom block definition: `name` (`/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,49}$/`, not a built-in tool name, unique case-insensitively), `label`, `blockType` (`simple` \| `embedded-entry`), `description`, `icon` (SVG, sanitised), `contentType`, `displayFields`, `titleField`, `previewFields`, `fields` (max 20: `name`, `label`, `type` text \| textarea \| url \| number \| select \| checkbox \| image \| color, `required`, `placeholder`, `default`, `options`), `template` (HTML with `{{field}}`, sanitised), `placeholder`, `styles` (allow-listed CSS properties), `inlineToolbar`, `tunes`, `shortcut`, `sortOrder`, `enabled`. Unknown keys are rejected.
- AI actions: `improve`, `grammar`, `shorten`, `expand`, `summarize`, `simplify`, `translate` (`language` one of English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Chinese), `tone` (`tone` one of professional, friendly, casual, confident, formal, persuasive), `continue`. Unknown action 404, text over `maxInputChars` 413, rate limit 429. Provider errors: `{ error: { name: 'AIProviderError', details: { code } } }` with codes `DISABLED` 503, `NOT_CONFIGURED` 503, `NO_API_KEY` 503, `AUTH_FAILED` 502, `PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT` 503, `TIMEOUT` 504, `REFUSED` 422, `PROVIDER_ERROR`/others 502.
- Settings `environment.csp`: `{ active, frameSrcMissing: string[], imgSrcMissing, snippet }` from `shared/csp.mjs` `inspectCsp(strapi.config.get('middlewares'))`, computed once at bootstrap. Only CSP sources are returned. The plugin never changes the CSP; `admin/src/editor/tools/csp-guard.js` shows a DOM-only placeholder (`data-mutation-free`) for blocked embeds and images.
- Quality rules (`shared/quality.mjs`): gallery images report `image-alt-missing` with the path `images.<n>.file.alt`; `video-no-captions` (warning) for a video without a `captions` or `subtitles` track; `extractLinks().media` lists every Media Library file id of image, gallery, video (file, poster, tracks) and audio blocks, so the link check reports missing files.
- `GET /config` also returns `data.quality: { externalLinks, scheduledLinks }`, `data.comments: { enabled }` and `permissions.commentsRead`, `commentsWrite`, `commentsModerate`.
- Quality (`services/quality.js`): internal links are checked per type with the Content Manager permission checker (`sanitizedQuery.read` filters + `documentId $in`, fields `documentId` only); an unreadable or unknown type answers `unknown` and is never queried; with read conditions a missing entry is `unknown`, without conditions `missing`; `draft` = Draft & Publish type without a published version. Media needs `plugin::upload.read`. External links only with `qualityChecks.externalLinks.enabled`, through `utils/url-security.js` `fetchBounded` (HEAD, GET on 405/501, 64/256 KB caps, max 4 concurrent), counter `links:<adminId>` in `magic_editor_x_counters`, 10-minute in-process cache (1,000 entries). Logs carry counts only.
- Scheduled link check (`services/link-schedule.js`, opt-in `qualityChecks.externalLinks.schedule`, requires `externalLinks.enabled`, validated at boot): bootstrap registers the cron job `magic-editor-x:link-check` with `strapi.cron.add` (rule: five fields, server time zone); destroy removes it. Every process fires; the one-time key `linkrun:<fire minute>` and the renewed lease `links:schedule` (5 min) in `magic_editor_x_locks` let one process run it. A run scans every `api::` type with editor fields (top level, components, dynamic zones; `guardQuery`/`collectGuarded` with `isEditorAttribute`) with the Document Service in batches of 50 ordered by id (`filters: { id: { $gt } }`), drafts and published versions (only `published` for types without Draft & Publish), `locale: '*'`; stores one row per field version with external links and marks each URL; then checks at most `maxUrlsPerRun` URLs (least recently checked first) through `quality.checkExternalUrl` (same SSRF-safe fetcher and 10-minute cache as the manual check), `perMinute` requests per minute (counter `links:schedule`), at most 4 in flight and `perHostConcurrency` per host. URLs not checked within the budget keep their earlier result or report `skipped`. Only after a complete scan are rows not seen in the run deleted (pruning). The run record (counts, times, `complete`, never URLs) is stored in the plugin store (`linkSchedule.lastRun`) and shown read-only in Settings > Configuration (`environment.linkSchedule: { enabled, scheduled, rule, maxUrlsPerRun, perMinute, lastRun: { finishedAt, complete, checked, problems } }`). Logs carry counts only. `qualityChecks.externalLinks.allowPrivateOrigins` lists exact origins (`URL.origin`) that may be private or loopback (intranet, test servers); requests to them do not follow redirects (a 3xx is reported as the result). Field permissions: `resolveEditorField` returns `permissionField` (`sections.body` inside components, the zone name inside dynamic zones), which `services/access.js` checks.
- Cron and clusters: Strapi 5.61 starts its cron service on every process and `strapi.cron.add` schedules plugin jobs regardless of `server.cron.enabled` (that flag only loads `server.cron.tasks`); the docs ask hosts to set `cron: { enabled: true }` in `config/server`, which the README recommends. Exactly-once execution comes from the plugin's lock rows, not from Strapi.
- Publish guard (`utils/publish-guard.js`): Document Service middleware on `publish` for Draft & Publish types with fields that have `options.publishGuard` (top level, components, dynamic zones); runs `lintDocument` with `requireAlt` on the drafts being published (locale string, array, `'*'` or none) and throws `ValidationError` `details: { code: 'QUALITY_GATE', issues: [{ field, rule, blockId, locale? }] (max 50), errors }` on error-severity issues.
- Settings: changing `provider` or `baseUrl` while a key is stored requires `apiKey` in the same request. `apiKey: ''` removes the stored key. Storing a key needs `MAGIC_EDITOR_X_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (or `encryptionKey`) with 32+ characters.

## Collaboration protocol (3)

1. The admin calls `POST /collaboration/session`. The server checks the shared per-admin session limit (`magic_editor_x_counters`, `collaboration.rateLimit.sessionsPerMinute`, 429), access (`services/access.js` `checkField`), seeds the room once from the stored draft (or `initialValue` when nothing is stored and the caller can edit; lease `seed:<room>`; every seed gets a new `meta.epoch`) and returns an HMAC-signed token (`admin.auth.secret`, HKDF purpose `magic-editor-x:collaboration-token`) with `{ room, target, userId, name, color, canEdit, protocol: 3, nonce, exp }`. Response `{ data: { token, path, canEdit, seeded, protocol, expiresAt } }`.
2. The browser opens Socket.IO on `path` with `transports: ['websocket']` and `auth: { token, protocol: 3 }`. A handshake middleware checks the origin (upgrade), protocol, signature, expiry, consumes the nonce once (`tok:<nonce>` lock) and the per-admin caps (`maxConnectionsPerAdmin`, `maxRoomsPerAdmin`, counted from fresh presence rows across processes). Refusals arrive as `connect_error` with `data.code`: `UPGRADE_REQUIRED`, `INVALID_TOKEN`, `TOO_MANY_CONNECTIONS`, `UNAVAILABLE`. Every reconnect requests a new token.
3. Events:

| Direction        | Event         | Payload                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| server -> client | `mx:welcome`  | `{ canEdit, presenceId, color, name, epoch, protocol }`                                                                                                                                              |
| server -> client | `mx:sync`     | `{ update, stateVector, epoch }` (full room state, or the missing part after `mx:resync`)                                                                                                            |
| client -> server | `mx:update`   | Yjs update bytes, ack `{ ok: true, id }` (`id` 0 when nothing new) or `{ ok: false, code: 'READ_ONLY' \| 'INVALID_UPDATE' \| 'RETRY' \| 'RATE_LIMITED' \| 'ROOM_FULL' \| 'STORE_FAILED' }`           |
| server -> client | `mx:update`   | Yjs update bytes from others                                                                                                                                                                         |
| client -> server | `mx:resync`   | client state vector (every 20 s, after reconnects and wake-ups; at most one per second)                                                                                                              |
| client -> server | `mx:cursor`   | `{ blockId, anchor, focus, idle }` (character offsets in the block's text; at most one per 50 ms)                                                                                                    |
| server -> client | `mx:presence` | `[{ id, name, color, canEdit, idle, cursor: { blockId, anchor, focus } \| null }]`; `color` is a Design System colour family (`primary`, `danger`, `success`, `warning`, `secondary`, `alternative`) |
| server -> client | `mx:role`     | `{ canEdit }` after a permission change                                                                                                                                                              |
| server -> client | `mx:error`    | `{ code: 'ACCESS_REVOKED' \| 'ROOM_RESET' \| 'INVALID_UPDATE' }` (the socket is closed after it)                                                                                                     |

4. Every process keeps an in-memory Y.Doc per room with local sockets. An update is checked by `shared/ydoc-guard.mjs` `applyCheckedUpdate` (allowed structures, dependencies present, touched blocks valid, field preset structure rules), appended to `magic_editor_x_collab_updates`, then acknowledged and relayed. `RETRY` means missing dependencies (nothing stored). Five refused updates close the socket. Per-socket budgets: `rateLimit.updatesPer10s`, `rateLimit.bytesPer10s`. Other processes poll rows with `id` above their watermark every `collaboration.pollIntervalMs` (rows of the last 5 seconds are re-read to tolerate commit order), apply them to their room and relay them; `compact` rows are not relayed; a `seed` row with a new epoch ends the room's sockets with `ROOM_RESET`. Rooms with 200+ rows are compacted under a lease. Rooms have a generation row `gen:<room>` in `magic_editor_x_locks` (owner = epoch). Appends run in a transaction that reads it with a shared lock and fail with `STALE_GENERATION` (answered `RETRY`) when the room moved on. Generation compaction (`collaboration.compaction`): when a room is idle for `idleSeconds`, at least `minBytes` and `ratio` times larger than a fresh encoding, one process (lease `compact:<room>`) writes a new `seed` row with a new epoch and deletes the old rows in one transaction (row lock on the generation row; aborted when rows were written meanwhile); every process switches its room and sends `mx:sync` with the new epoch; updates of client ids from older generations get `RETRY`. `applyCheckedUpdate` stores every update that advances the state vector.
5. Automatic versions: lock `snap:<room>:t<bucket>` when a `snapshotIntervalMinutes` bucket with changes ends (the first tick after it) and `snap:<room>:end<lastId>` when the last local socket leaves; the lease is released when creating the version fails. Maintenance (under the `maintenance` lease) prunes presence, locks and counters and deletes rooms idle for `roomTtlMinutes` without presence after a final version (`end<lastId>`, skipped when equal to the saved draft).
6. Permissions: a lifecycle subscriber on `admin::permission`, `admin::role` and `admin::user` sets the lock row `signal:permissions` to a new value; every process compares it every second and re-checks all sockets (`mx:role` or `ACCESS_REVOKED`). Full re-check every `collaboration.revalidateSeconds`.
7. Client (`admin/src/editor/collab-client.js`): one update in flight, later edits merged; unacknowledged edits kept across disconnects; backoff 0.5 s to 15 s with jitter and a manual reconnect after handshake refusals; `online`, `offline`, `visibilitychange` and `pagehide` handled; idle after 60 s or when hidden; a new epoch or `INVALID_UPDATE` starts over with fresh documents (unsent edits are rebased onto the new room after a new epoch, with the acknowledged server state as base and the editor view as the diff base). Undo/redo use the replica's Y.UndoManager (own changes only).

Tables (created in `services/store.js`, not content types):

- `magic_editor_x_collab_updates (id, room, kind 'seed'|'update'|'compact', data base64, size, created_at)`
- `magic_editor_x_collab_presence (id, room, user_id, name, color, can_edit, cursor, updated_at)`
- `magic_editor_x_locks (key, owner, expires_at)` (leases, one-time keys, `signal:*` rows)
- `magic_editor_x_counters (key, count, expires_at)` (fixed-window counters: `session:<adminId>`, `ai:<adminId>`, `links:<adminId>`, `links:schedule`, `comments:<adminId>`)
- `magic_editor_x_link_fields (key sha256(uid|documentId|locale or -|field|version), uid, document_id, locale, field, version 'draft'|'published', links JSON [{ h: url hash, b: blockId }] max 200, run_id, scanned_at)`
- `magic_editor_x_link_urls (hash sha256(url), url, status, code, checked_at, run_id)`

Room key: `<uid>|<documentId>|<locale or ->|<field>`, the same as `roomId` of versions.

## Collaboration document model (schema 3, `shared/ydoc.mjs`)

```text
Y.Doc
├─ meta   Y.Map   { schema: 3, time: number, version: string, epoch: string }
├─ order  Y.Array<string>                 block ids in document order (duplicates from concurrent moves keep the first position)
└─ blocks Y.Map<blockId, Y.Map>           entries are never deleted; `order` decides visibility
     └─ { type: string,
          tunes: Y.Map  (structured like data),
          data:  Y.Map  JSON object -> Y.Map, array -> Y.Array, string -> Y.Text, number/boolean/null -> plain value }
```

- Inline formatting stays HTML inside the Y.Text (the Editor.js string), so the stored JSON and the tool contracts are unchanged. Range anchors (`Y.RelativePosition`) on these texts are possible; they point into the HTML source. Formatting as Yjs attributes is not used (the guard refuses `ContentFormat`).
- Writing: `applyLocalChanges(doc, base, local, origin)` applies the change `base -> local` structurally (text diff on Y.Text, LCS alignment for arrays with in-place merges of changed items, key-wise for maps). `applyEditorDataToDoc` is the two-way form. `createSeedUpdate(data, epoch)`, `epochOf(doc)`, `docToEditorData(doc)`, `createDocReader(doc)` (incremental), `readShared`/`toShared` (depth-bounded).
- `shared/collab-replica.mjs`: `doc` (shared state) plus `shadow` (what the editor shows). Local edits are diffed against the shadow and applied to `doc` as a Yjs update (origin `LOCAL_ORIGIN`), so Yjs merges them by item identity. `snapshot()` / `markShown(catchUp, shown)` / `rebase(from, data)` / `undo()` / `redo()`.
- Schema 2 rooms (2.0) read with the same reader; values are converted to their structured form on the first local change. 1.x states: `legacyStateToEditorData(update)`.

## Version history

Content type `plugin::magic-editor-x.document-snapshot` (table `magic_editor_doc_snapshots`, 1.x columns kept): `roomId`, `contentType`, `entryId`, `entryLocale`, `fieldName`, `version`, `trigger` (`manual` \| `auto` \| `restore` \| `legacy`), `contentHash`, `jsonContent`, `yjsSnapshot` (1.x only), `createdBy`. Versions are numbered under the lease `snapver:<room>`; a version identical to the latest one is not stored. Old versions beyond `history.maxSnapshotsPerField` are deleted. `label` (string 120, optional) names a version; `history.rename(documentId, label)`. Restoring replaces the editor content in the browser; the normal Content Manager save stores it. `shared/diff.mjs` `diffDocuments(before, after)` aligns blocks by id (LCS, moved = outside the longest increasing run), pairs unmatched blocks by type and word similarity, diffs text word by word on `inlineToText` (whole replacement above 2000 tokens) and returns plain text only: the diff view renders text nodes, never HTML. `admin/src/editor/restore-block.mjs` restores one block (`blocks.update`, or `insert(..., replace, id)` keeping the id).

## Renderers, schema, types

- `magic-editor-x/render` (`shared/render`, bundled to `dist/render/index.{mjs,js}` by `scripts/build-server-bundle.mjs`, types `dist/render/index.d.ts`): `renderHtml(value, options)`, `renderTree`, `serializeNodes`, `renderText`, `renderMarkdown`, plus `escapeHtml`, `escapeMarkdown`, `inlineToHtml`, `inlineToText`, `DEFAULT_EMBED_HOSTS`, `enhanceCodeBlocks(root?)`, `copyText`. Options: `overrides[type](block, helpers)`, `links(ref) -> href|false|null` (checked with `sanitizeUrl`), `media(file) -> file` (re-validated), `rawHtml: 'allow'` + `sanitizeRaw`, `embedHosts`, `imageSizes`, `code: { lineNumbers?: boolean | 'block', copyButton?: boolean | { label, copiedLabel, failedLabel } }`, `focalPoint: 'data' | 'style'`. Inline HTML is re-parsed by `render/inline.mjs` `parseInline` (allow-list from the sanitize policy, entities decoded before URL checks, dangerous containers dropped with content) and turned into nodes by `inlineToNodes`. No dependencies, no Node built-ins, no framework imports (`tests/render-tree.test.mjs` checks the import graph, `verify:runtime` checks the bundles), deterministic.
- Render tree (`render/tree.mjs`): `createTreeBuilder(value, options, mode)` builds nodes `{ type: 'element', tag, attrs, children }` (lower-case names; attrs are strings or `true`), `{ type: 'text', value }` and `{ type: 'raw', html }`, plus internal `{ type: 'block', block, children }` wrappers that the React/Vue components use for `components`/slots; `renderTree` removes the wrappers. Blocks are separated by `\n` text nodes. A raw node only comes from `sanitizeRaw` (opt-in) and is always the only child of its element; adapters drop any other raw node. `renderHtml` = `serializeNodes(builder.nodes)` and is byte-identical to 2.2 (`tests/render.test.mjs`, `tests/render-tree.test.mjs`).
- **Adding a block type** (gallery, video, audio, table of contents, mention, ...): one entry in `RENDERERS` in `render/tree.mjs` returning `el(tag, attrs, children)` nodes (or null to omit) gives HTML, React and Vue output; add the matching entries in `render/text.mjs` and `render/markdown.mjs`, the policy/schema/types for the stored data, and a case in `tests/helpers/xss-corpus.mjs` `xssDocument`, so the React/Vue parity test covers it. Never build HTML strings in a renderer; boolean attributes are `true`, absent ones `undefined`/`false`. New attribute names that React spells differently go into `PROP_NAMES` (and `BOOLEAN_PROPS` for booleans) in `frameworks/react.mjs`.
- Overrides: return nodes (`helpers.h`, `helpers.textNode`, `helpers.inlineNodes`, `helpers.childNodes`), validated by `cleanOverrideNodes` (tag/attribute name patterns, no `on*`/`style`/`srcdoc`, denied tags such as script/style/object/form, URL attributes and `srcset` through `sanitizeUrl`, raw nodes dropped), or a string. A string is HTML: `renderHtml` writes it as it is (2.2 contract, the override escapes); in `renderTree` and the components it is used only with `rawHtml: 'allow'` + `sanitizeRaw`, as the raw child of `<div class="mex-override" data-mex-block="<type>">`, else the default output. `undefined`/`null`/numbers keep the default.
- Media (2.3): gallery `<figure class="mex-gallery mex-gallery-<layout> mex-gallery-cols-<n>" data-mex-layout data-mex-columns><ul class="mex-gallery-items"><li class="mex-gallery-item"><figure class="mex-gallery-figure"><img ...><figcaption>` + optional gallery `<figcaption>`; video `<figure class="mex-video"><video src controls preload="metadata" aria-label=<title> loop? playsinline muted? poster? width? height?><track kind src srclang label default?>…<a href=<file>>title</a></video><figcaption>`; audio the same with `<audio>` (no playsinline/muted/poster). Text: captions/alt (gallery), title + caption or the URL (video/audio); Markdown: one image per line (gallery), `[title](<url>)` + caption (video/audio). The `media(file)` hook runs for every file (gallery images, video/audio files, posters, tracks) and its result is re-validated for that kind.
- Focal point (image blocks, gallery images): default output `data-mex-focal-x`/`data-mex-focal-y` (0..1) on `<img>`, no inline style (CSP friendly: CSS cannot read the attributes into `object-position`, so a frontend that crops with `object-fit: cover` sets `img.style.objectPosition` from them in script, which the CSSOM allows under a strict `style-src`, or uses its framework's style binding). `focalPoint: 'style'` adds `style="object-position:X% Y%"`: the element node gets `style: { 'object-position': 'X% Y%' }` (`nodes.mjs` `safeStyle` allows only this property with percentage values; overrides cannot set it), React gets the `style` prop `{ objectPosition }`, Vue `{ 'object-position' }`. Media Library formats are resized, not cropped, so the same percentages hold for every `srcset` candidate.
- Code blocks: `language-<lang>` on `<code>` for codeFlask (language validated by the policy, `plaintext` fallback). `lineNumbers` adds `mex-code-lines` to `<pre>` and one `<span class="mex-code-line">` per line (newlines kept between spans, numbers from CSS counters, off above `MAX_NUMBERED_LINES` = 20000 lines); `'block'` follows codeFlask `showlinenumbers`. `copyButton` wraps the block in `<div class="mex-code-block" data-mex-code="copy">` with `<button type="button" class="mex-code-copy" data-mex-copy="code" data-mex-copied data-mex-failed>` and `<span class="mex-code-copy-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">`. Defaults off, so 2.2 output is unchanged. Markdown and text keep code as fenced (with language) or plain text.
- `magic-editor-x/react` (`shared/frameworks/react.mjs`, `dist/react`, types `types/react.d.ts`): `MagicEditorXContent({ value, options, components })` (fragment, no hooks except in the copy block, which renders static markup when `React.useState` is missing as in React Server Components) and `treeToReact(nodes)`. `components[type]` receives `{ block, helpers: { text, url, inline, renderBlocks }, children }`. `createElement` only; `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` only for raw nodes. React 18 and 19 (peer `^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0`; React is the admin's peer, no extra install).
- `magic-editor-x/vue` (`shared/frameworks/vue.mjs`, `dist/vue`, types `types/vue.d.ts`): `MagicEditorXContent` (props `value`, `options`, `components`; scoped slots `block-<type>` with `{ block, helpers, children }` win over `components`, which get `block`/`helpers` props and the default output as default slot) and `treeToVue(nodes)`. `h()` only; `innerHTML` only for raw nodes; `true` attributes become ''. Vue is an optional peer (`^3.5.0`, `peerDependenciesMeta`) and a devDependency for tests.
- Both component bundles keep the framework external and bundle the renderer core. `tests/render-frameworks.test.mjs` renders the XSS corpus, fixtures and 1.x values through React `renderToStaticMarkup` and Vue `renderToString` and compares them with `renderHtml` after normalisation (htmlparser2: comments dropped, attributes sorted, entities decoded).
- `magic-editor-x/schema` (JSON Schema 2020-12, `$defs/data_<type>`), `magic-editor-x/types` (`MagicEditorXData`, `MagicEditorXBlock`, `BlockDataMap`, render types).
- `services/links.js` `resolveHrefs(value, { status })` re-renders internal-link hrefs from `links.urlPattern` and current slugs (server code, no permission checks). For permission-checked output use `services/references.js` `transform(items, { format, auth, status })` (see Content API and GraphQL output).

## Content API and GraphQL output (2.3)

Opt-in per request; without it responses are unchanged.

- REST: `?mex=html|text|markdown|json` on GET requests of Content API routes whose handler belongs to an `api::` content type (core `find`/`findOne` of collection and single types, and custom GET actions of the same controller). `middlewares/render-output.js` (registered with `strapi.server.use` in bootstrap) walks `ctx.body.data` along the schema (`utils/output-walk.js`: top-level fields, components, dynamic zones, populated relations; flat and `Strapi-Response-Format: v4` responses) and **replaces** every Magic Editor X value: `json` -> the stored document with resolved references (object or `null`), `html`/`text`/`markdown` -> the rendered string (`''` when empty). Raw HTML blocks are left out of rendered strings (renderer default). Admin routes (`route.info.type !== 'content-api'`), plugin routes and non-200 responses are never touched. Any other `mex` value (also repeated) -> 400 `ValidationError` `details: { key: 'mex', source: 'query', param: 'mex' }`, checked before the controller. An unexpected failure answers 500 with Strapi's generic body (never the stored values).
- `mex` is registered in `register.js` with `strapi.contentAPI.addQueryParams({ mex: { schema: z.enum([...]).optional(), matchRoute: GET routes with route.info.apiName } })` (Strapi's documented way to add Content API query params), so it passes with `api.rest.strictParams: true`. Strapi strips registered extra params before the Document Service. Strapi versions without `addQueryParams` accept `mex` only without strict params.
- Resolution (`services/references.js`, pure parts in `shared/resolve-references.mjs`), always with the caller's Content API auth (`ctx.state.auth`, GraphQL `context.state.auth`):
  - a target type is read only when `strapi.auth.verify(auth, { scope: ['<uid>.find'] })` passes (API tokens: full access, read-only, custom per action; users-permissions user or public role; same rule Strapi applies to populated relations); `api::` types only; Media Library files need `plugin::upload.content-api.find`;
  - Document Service `findMany({ filters: { documentId: { $in } }, locale, status })`, one query per type and locale (types without i18n: one per type), media one `db.query('plugin::upload.file')` query by id/documentId, custom-block definitions one query; `status` is `published` unless the REST request has `status=draft` (GraphQL: `draft` when the parent's `publishedAt` is `null`); every row passes `strapi.contentAPI.sanitize.output(row, model, { auth })` before any field is used;
  - bounds: 500 distinct references and 5 s per response (`LIMITS`); references over the limit or after the time budget stay unresolved; logs carry counts only.
- Results: internal link -> `href` from `links.urlPattern` with the sanitised slug (`renderLinkPattern`); unresolved (missing, draft-only, unreadable type, over the limit) -> the `<a>` is removed and only its text stays (no href, no reference attributes). Embedded entry (custom block with `data.entry.documentId` and `data.contentType` `api::`) -> `data.entry = { ...displayFields, id, documentId, title, href }` from the sanitised live row (display fields: the custom block's `displayFields` plus the keys of the stored summary, scalar values only; title: `titleField`, then `title`, `name`, `label`, then the first text attribute), unresolved -> `data.entry = null` (the stored snapshot is dropped); rendered as `<div class="mex-block mex-entry mex-<type>" data-mex-block><a class="mex-entry-link" href>title</a></div>`, `[title](<href>)` or the title, nothing when unresolved. Image with `file.id`/`file.documentId` -> current `url`, `name`, `mime`, `ext`, `hash`, `width`, `height`, `size`, `formats`; `alt` only when the block has none; unresolved -> the stored file as stored. The same applies to every Media Library file slot (`shared/resolve-references.mjs` `mediaSlots`): gallery images and video posters like images, video/audio files and track files without `alt` and `formats`; all need `plugin::upload.content-api.find`. Internal links keep `data-mex-*` attributes in resolved output. Link titles are not added (the link text is authored content).
- GraphQL (`server/src/graphql.js`, registered in `register.js` through `strapi.plugin('graphql').service('extension').use(...)` only when the GraphQL plugin is installed): for every Magic Editor X attribute `x` of an `api::` content type or a component that is in the schema (`typeRegistry.has`), not private, output not disabled by `shadowCRUD(uid).field(x)`, and without an attribute named `xRendered`/`xResolved`: `xRendered(format: MagicEditorXFormat = HTML): String` (`HTML`, `TEXT`, `MARKDOWN`) and `xResolved: JSON`. Same resolution; values requested in one tick of a request are resolved in one batch per publication status. Component fields resolve against published versions and the default locale for links without a locale.
- `services/links.js` `resolveHrefs` is unchanged (server helper without permission checks).

## Paste, convert, migrate

- `shared/convert`: `htmlToBlocks(html, { parse, dataImages })` -> `{ blocks, report: { skipped, images } }` (pasted `<video>`/`<audio>` are skipped and reported as `unsupported-element`: media blocks hold Media Library files only; several pasted images become separate `image` blocks) on a minimal node interface (`dom-adapter.mjs` for DOMParser, `htmlparser-adapter.mjs` for htmlparser2), `markdownToBlocks(md, { parse? })` (marked lexer, GFM; raw HTML via htmlToBlocks or escaped), `strapiBlocksToEditor(value)`, `looksLikeMarkdown(text)`. Output uses only the editor's own tags; ids are deterministic (`cv<hash><index>`). marked and htmlparser2 are ESM-only and bundled into the server build.
- `admin/src/editor/paste.js` `createPasteHandler({ holder, editor, t, isAllowed, allowedHeadingLevels, uploadImageByUrl, uploadImageFile, canUpload, notify, onInserted })`: capture-phase paste on the holder; office HTML, 2+ block tags or Markdown text; never in code/raw/table cells/inputs; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V plain text; images via the upload routes (10 per paste, data: images max 5 MB, jpeg/png/gif/webp/avif), `file:`/`blob:` never fetched. Pure rules in `paste-logic.mjs`.
- `services/migrate.js` `run({ uid, from, to, format, locale, status, dryRun = true, overwrite, batchSize, limit })` (strict zod; `to` a top-level Magic Editor X field; `from` blocks/richtext/text/string/json; never writes `from`; skips a target with content unless `overwrite`) -> report `{ uid, from, to, format, dryRun, scanned, converted, skippedExisting, skippedEmpty, failed: [{ documentId, locale, code }], lossy: [{ documentId, locale, notes }] }`. `bin/magic-editor-x.mjs migrate` boots Strapi (`compileStrapi`, `createStrapi().load()`), routes Strapi's stdout to stderr, prints the report, exit 1 on failures.

## Editor field extras

- Markdown shortcuts (`editor/markdown-shortcuts*.{js,mjs}`), find and replace (`shared/find-replace.mjs` + `FindReplacePanel`, CSS Custom Highlight `mex-find`), shortcuts dialog (Ctrl/Cmd+/), focus mode, `BlockSelectionBar` (Editor.js `.ce-block--selected`), quality panel (`QualityPanel`, `useQualityIssues`) with preset violations, `lang`/`dir` from the content locale. The image tool is `MexImageTool` (`tools/alt-text.js`, subclass of `@editorjs/image` adding alt text, the decorative flag and the focal point control). Media tools (`tools/media.js`: `GalleryTool`, `VideoTool`, `AudioTool`; pure logic in `tools/media-logic.mjs`; focal point control `tools/focal-point.js`: disclosure button, click/tap on the preview, arrow keys 1 % / Shift 10 %, reset, polite live value) open the Strapi Media Library dialog through `openMediaLibrary({ multiple, allowedTypes: ['images'|'videos'|'audios'|'files'], accept(asset), onSelect(assets) })`; `EditorField` filters the picked assets with `accept` and returns focus to the trigger. They are offered only with `plugin::upload.read` (`config.permissions.mediaLibrary`, tool config `canBrowse`); without it they are hidden from the toolbox and existing blocks explain why no files can be chosen. Gallery: add (multiple), move earlier/later, remove, per-image alt (default: the file's Media Library alternative text; `requireAlt`/decorative as in the image block), caption, focal point, layout and columns. Video/audio: choose/replace, title, caption, loop (+ muted and poster for video), WebVTT tracks (kind, language defaulting to the content locale, label, one default).
- `apply-remote.js`: default tune values count as "no tune" in `blockKey`; more than 150 changed blocks (and a quarter of the document) are applied with one `render` instead of per-block updates (Editor.js notifies every block on each mutation).

## Block comments (2.3)

- Content type `plugin::magic-editor-x.comment` (table `magic_editor_comments`, hidden from the Content Manager and the Content-Type Builder, no Content API route): `contentType`, `entryId`, `entryLocale` (null for types without i18n), `fieldName` (the version / room key `uid|documentId|locale|field` as columns), `blockId` (Editor.js block id, `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`), `threadId` (documentId of the root; null on the root), `excerpt` (root only, plain one-line text, max 200), `body` (plain text, max 4000 after `normalizeCommentBody`: CRLF to LF, tabs to spaces, C0/C1 controls, bidi overrides and zero-width marks removed, at most two blank lines), `authorId` (admin id) + `authorName` (name snapshot), `editedAt`, `resolved`, `resolvedAt`, `resolvedById` + `resolvedByName`. Access through `services/comments.js` (query engine).
- API shapes: thread `{ id, blockId, excerpt, status: 'open'|'resolved', resolvedAt, resolvedBy: { name }|null, createdAt, updatedAt (latest activity), comments: [comment] }`; comment `{ id, threadId, body, author: { name|null, own, deleted }, createdAt, updatedAt, editedAt }`. Admin ids are never returned; `own` tells the caller whether they wrote it. Comments are never part of the field value, version history or Content API output.
- Rules: every route needs `access` + `comments.read` and Content Manager read on the document, locale and field (`services/access.js` `checkField`, 404 otherwise; a comment id of another document answers 404 too). Commenting, replying, resolving and reopening need `comments.write` but no update right (reviewers). Editing: author only. Deleting: own comment with `comments.write`; anyone's, or a thread with replies by other people, with `comments.moderate`. Limits: `comments.perMinute` new comments per admin (counter `comments:<adminId>` in `magic_editor_x_counters`, 429), 1000 comments per field and locale, 200 replies per thread (400 `TOO_MANY_COMMENTS`). Handlers log nothing.
- Retention (`utils/comment-retention.js`): a Document Service middleware deletes the comments of every document locale a `delete` removed (`result.entries[].locale`), after the delete; an `admin::user` `afterDelete` lifecycle clears `authorId`/`authorName` and `resolvedById`/`resolvedByName` of the deleted admin (the text stays, shown as "Deleted user"). Rows written around the Document Service (raw SQL, `db.query`) are not cleaned up.
- Admin: toolbar toggle with the open-thread count, `CommentsPanel` (pattern of the quality panel: new thread on a chosen block, open threads first, detached threads (block no longer in the document) still readable and resolvable, "Show resolved threads", reply, resolve/reopen, edit/delete own with ConfirmDialog, live region) and `CommentMarkers` (button with the open-thread count at the inline end of each block, rendered next to the Editor.js holder, never inside it). `useComments` polls `GET /comments` every 15 s while the field is on screen and the tab visible (8 s with the panel open), on window focus and after every own action; the database is the source of truth, so it works across processes. Config `comments.enabled: false` hides the UI and the routes answer 404.

## Configuration

Defaults and validation in `server/src/config/index.js` (the README has the table): `debug`, `rawHtml`, `sanitizeOnSave`, `encryptionKey`, `uploads.maxImageBytes`, `uploads.maxFileBytes`, `linkPreview.enabled`, `linkPreview.timeoutMs`, `api.autoParseJSON`, `ai.allowPrivateBaseUrl`, `ai.apiKey`, `ai.requestsPerMinute`, `ai.timeoutMs`, `collaboration.enabled`, `collaboration.path`, `collaboration.allowedOrigins`, `collaboration.pollIntervalMs`, `collaboration.roomTtlMinutes`, `collaboration.maxMessageBytes`, `collaboration.snapshotIntervalMinutes`, `collaboration.tokenTtlSeconds`, `collaboration.maxConnectionsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.maxRoomsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.revalidateSeconds`, `collaboration.rateLimit.sessionsPerMinute`, `collaboration.rateLimit.updatesPer10s`, `collaboration.rateLimit.bytesPer10s`, `collaboration.compaction` (`enabled`, `idleSeconds`, `minBytes`, `ratio`, `checkIntervalSeconds`), `history.maxSnapshotsPerField`, `comments.enabled`, `comments.perMinute`, `links.urlPattern` (validated by `isValidLinkPattern`), `qualityChecks.externalLinks` (`enabled`, `timeoutMs`, `perMinute`, `allowPrivateOrigins`, `schedule`: `enabled`, `rule`, `maxUrlsPerRun`, `perMinute`, `perHostConcurrency`). Environment: `MAGIC_EDITOR_X_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. Read config inside functions, never at module load. Arrays have empty defaults because Strapi merges config arrays by index.

## Admin and i18n

- Build every screen with `@strapi/design-system` and the admin `Page`/`Layouts`; colours and spacing from theme tokens only (no hex, no `var(--colors-*)`; 1rem = 10px). Destructive actions use `ConfirmDialog`. No `window.confirm`, no `console.log`, no emoji.
- Translation keys live in four areas, `admin/src/translations/{common,editor,tools,settings}/{en,de,fr,es,pt}.json`, prefixed with the area (`editor.history.title`). Every key exists in all five locales; German uses formal "Sie". The `defaultMessage` in code equals the English text. `tests/admin-i18n.test.mjs` enforces parity, ICU validity and no orphans.
- Editor tools in `admin/src/editor/tools` keep the 1.x block names and data. Untrusted strings reach `innerHTML` only through `sanitizeInline`, `sanitizeTemplate` or `sanitizeSvg` from `admin/src/editor/sanitize.js`.

## Releases

Conventional commits (angular preset). A breaking change needs a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer; `!` alone is not counted by the commit analyzer. semantic-release publishes from `main`; the hand-written `## [Unreleased]` section of CHANGELOG.md is folded into the release notes by `scripts/release-unreleased.mjs`.
